entries.title: Brainspotting: smoother sessions, and your settings remembered
entries.summary: Brainspotting now remembers how you like to work — speed, color, sound, and mode carry over between sessions instead of resetting each time. Press the spacebar to pause mid-processing without reaching for the mouse, and the tool honors your system's reduced-motion setting. If a tab closes unexpectedly, your session is offered back to you on reopen, and the end-of-session screen is now a clearer Session Review.

entries.title: Life Map: hand off to EMDR with context
entries.summary: Click the EMDR button on a Life Map target and the BLS tool now shows the target's name, negative cognition, and SUDS at the top of the canvas. No more mentally carrying clinical details across tabs.

entries.title: Genogram: better relationship symbols
entries.summary: Hostile relationships now render as a clear zigzag (the standard genogram convention) rather than a flat line — much easier to spot at a glance. Volatile (close + hostile combined), Distant, and Separated are new types. Abuse can be sub-categorized as Physical, Sexual, or Emotional with a small badge.

entries.title: Genogram: privacy and crash recovery
entries.summary: Genograms no longer auto-load on open — the tool always starts blank. If you close the tab unexpectedly, you'll see a Keep / Discard banner the next time you open it. Any genogram autosaved before this change gets a one-time migration prompt so nothing is lost.

entries.title: Life Map: won't silently lose your work
entries.summary: Clicking outside the target details modal no longer dismisses unsaved edits. A subtle bug that wiped custom negative cognitions on re-open is fixed. Crash recovery now offers a recovery banner if you closed the tab without exporting.

entries.title: Across the suite: UX polish
entries.summary: Cleaner empty states with a clear first action. Escape closes any modal. Smoother zoom (hold Cmd or Ctrl while scrolling). People in Genogram now show a grab cursor on hover. Zoom percentage readout in Genogram. Many small fixes throughout.

entries.title: Guided EMDR: downloadable session reports
entries.summary: Plain-text session reports for charting. All five protocols (Standard, Recent Event, Present Trigger, Flash-Forward, Future Template) are supported.
